title: Sun in the 1st house (Lagna)
text: The Sun in the ascendant gives a strong constitution, a commanding presence and self-confidence. The native is ambitious, somewhat impatient, and drawn to positions of leadership. Health concerns may centre on the eyes or the head, and ego can overshadow diplomacy.

title: Sun in the 4th house
text: The Sun in the fourth can unsettle domestic peace and one's relationship with the mother, and may indicate frequent change of residence. Property matters carry tension, yet the native often rises to a respected standing later in life.

title: Sun in the 7th house
text: The Sun in the seventh can strain partnership and marriage through pride or domination, and business partnerships require care. Ego friction with the spouse is a recurring theme that softens with maturity.

title: Sun in the 10th house
text: The Sun in the tenth is a classic placement for career success, authority and recognition. The native gains standing through government, administration or positions of command, and the reputation tends to grow over time. This is counted among the strongest positions for the Sun.

title: Moon in the 1st house
text: The Moon in the ascendant gives an emotional, receptive and imaginative nature. The native is sensitive to surroundings and moods, charming in company, and often good-looking. Emotional stability depends greatly on the Moon's waxing or waning state.

title: Moon in the 4th house
text: The Moon in the fourth, its natural house, brings emotional contentment at home, a close bond with the mother, and comforts such as property and vehicles. The mind finds peace in domestic life, and the later years are generally settled.

title: Moon in the 7th house
text: The Moon in the seventh favours an attractive, affectionate spouse and emotional closeness in marriage. The native values companionship highly and may be drawn to public-facing or people-centred work.

title: Moon in the 10th house
text: The Moon in the tenth supports a career connected to the public, nurturing fields, liquids, or changeable environments. Reputation fluctuates with circumstance, but adaptability and popularity aid professional progress.

title: Mars in the 1st house
text: Mars in the ascendant gives energy, courage, a competitive drive and physical strength. The native is bold and direct, but prone to anger, haste and accidents or scars. This is one component of the Manglik (Kuja dosha) consideration.

title: Mars in the 7th house
text: Mars in the seventh is a principal Manglik placement and can bring friction, impatience or conflict into marriage and partnerships. Energy in the relationship is high; conscious patience and a compatible partner greatly ease the effect.

title: Mars in the 10th house
text: Mars in the tenth is excellent for careers demanding drive, discipline and command — the military, engineering, surgery, sport or enterprise. It gives ambition and the capacity for sustained hard work, and is a form of directional strength (digbala) for Mars.

title: Mercury in the 1st house
text: Mercury in the ascendant gives intelligence, wit, a youthful appearance and skill with words and numbers. The native is communicative, analytical and adaptable, with an aptitude for learning, writing and commerce.

title: Mercury in the 10th house
text: Mercury in the tenth favours careers in communication, trade, writing, accounting, analysis and intellect-driven professions. The native prospers through skill, versatility and networking, and often holds more than one line of work.

title: Jupiter in the 1st house
text: Jupiter in the ascendant is highly auspicious, giving wisdom, optimism, good ethics and a dignified presence. The native tends toward learning, teaching and spirituality, enjoys general good fortune, and is protected in difficulty. A form of directional strength for Jupiter.

title: Jupiter in the 5th house
text: Jupiter in the fifth blesses children, education, intelligence and creative or devotional pursuits. It gives sound judgement, success in teaching or advisory roles, and a virtuous, fortunate turn of mind.

title: Jupiter in the 9th house
text: Jupiter in the ninth, the house of fortune and dharma, is among the most auspicious placements. It gives faith, higher learning, long journeys, a philosophical outlook and the support of teachers and elders. Prosperity and good fortune are strongly indicated.

title: Venus in the 1st house
text: Venus in the ascendant gives beauty, charm, a pleasing manner and a love of comfort, art and refinement. The native is attractive to others, diplomatic and sociable, with good fortune in relationships and the arts.

title: Venus in the 7th house
text: Venus in the seventh, its natural house of relationship, favours a happy marriage, an attractive and loving partner, and harmony in partnerships. The native enjoys companionship, pleasure and often gains through marriage or joint ventures.

title: Saturn in the 1st house
text: Saturn in the ascendant gives a serious, disciplined and reserved nature, often with early hardships that build resilience. The native matures slowly but steadily, succeeds through patience and endurance, and tends to look older than their years.

title: Saturn in the 7th house
text: Saturn in the seventh can delay marriage but, once settled, often gives a stable, lasting and dutiful partnership, sometimes with an older or more mature partner. It rewards commitment and patience in relationships and business alike.

title: Saturn in the 10th house
text: Saturn in the tenth is a strong karmic placement for career, giving steady rise through sustained effort, responsibility and discipline. Success comes gradually but endures; the native is suited to administration, labour-related fields, law or long-term institutions. A form of directional strength for Saturn.

title: Rahu in the 1st house
text: Rahu in the ascendant gives an unconventional, ambitious and magnetic personality, often with an unusual appearance or outlook. The native is drawn to foreign things and worldly achievement, but should guard against restlessness, confusion of identity and over-reaching.

title: Ketu in the 1st house
text: Ketu in the ascendant gives a detached, introspective and spiritually inclined nature. The native may feel uncertain about identity or appearance, is drawn to the mystical, and benefits from inner work and letting go of material over-attachment.
